verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led petition drafting and filing, so running the product headlessly or in CI is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, API, or automation mode. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, and the only digital surface is a client document portal, which does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
